purpose: Prepare a small grammar-reference diagnostic for the synthetic-data quality judge, not RoGuard response or concern qualification.
expected_reference_selection: Up to32 different documents, at most one complete line per document with exactly one explicit grammar-tag annotation and no other annotation or unexplained markup; source and corrected text must differ. Character length40..400 and6..60 whitespace tokens. Retain original and corrected strings exactly, without rewriting.
pair_order: First eligible line in each deterministically ordered document. Do not select by any model output.
limitations: Grammar-reference comparison only. A proofreader edit does not establish absolute naturalness; domain and severity differ from assistant replies. No independent RoGuard behavior labels are inferred.
